options.text: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.player: Why did you join the Emissaries?

steps.text: If Silia is not the traitor:

steps.npc: I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be serving the will of Ralos.
I always knew people were wrong about me. I knew I would serve a higher purpose. I never cared what it was. I only cared that in doing so, I would be granted a place in Mictl.
I have served Ralos my whole life. I am his humble servant. It was he who guided me here so that I may serve his will.

options.text: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.player: Tell me about the Final Dawn.

steps.text: If Silia is not the traitor:

steps.npc: The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world so that he and Ranul can build a new one.
The Final Dawn is an end, but also a beginning. It is when Ralos will use his holy fire to destroy this world. Then he and Ranul will guide us to Mictl.
